name: Camera tour over one canvas

source.description: 2 inspected reference films (batch-3, batch-6, 2026-11-26): a light AI demo lays every panel on one ivory canvas and moves a virtual camera between them, with no cut in 30 s.

technique: All the screens of a demo live on one large canvas, and a virtual camera pans, pushes in and pulls back to frame each step. There is never a cut, so the viewer always knows where each panel sits relative to the others.
purpose: Keep the viewer oriented across several screens of a demo: each step is framed by a camera move, never a cut, so every panel keeps its place relative to the others.
visual_behaviour: The camera pushes in, pans and pulls back over one large canvas of panels; elements that travel between panels are followed by the camera; a final pull-back shows the whole canvas.
mechanics: Lay panels out on a canvas 2-3x the frame. Animate one camera transform (translate and scale) per step: a push-in or pan of 0.6-1.0 s with power2.inOut, then a 2-5 s hold with a slow drift (scale +2-3%). Elements that move between panels travel in canvas space while the camera follows them (ref-ad023ce9dc 17.9-18.7 s). End with a pull-back that shows the whole canvas (25.19-25.9 s).

decomposition.timing: Moves 0.6-1.0 s; holds 2-5 s; 4 moves in 30 s in the reference.

parameters.name: hold
parameters.description: Seconds the camera rests on a step

parameters.name: drift_scale
parameters.description: Scale reached by the slow drift during a hold

use_cases: Product or workflow demo across several panels
A system diagram too big for one frame
Showing a detail, then its place in the whole
failure_modes: Moving the camera and the content at the same time with no focus point confuses the eye
Fast pans over dense text are unreadable; ease in and out and hold

implementation.approach: Studio.space.tour(tl, canvas, stops, opts) (runtime 1.18.0): one transform on a canvas larger than the frame; per stop a 0.8 s power2.inOut move framing the target with padding, a sine drift to 1.025x about the target centre while holding, optional pull-back to the whole canvas; marks the canvas data-layout-allow-overflow for frame review.

provenance.observed: Four camera moves over one ivory canvas of panels (follow the image, push in, pan, pull back); 0 cuts in 30 s.

Silent variant on a dark terminal: the camera pushes into the chart (11.5-13.8 s), goes macro on the candles (13.8-17.0 s), pulls back to the order book (17.1-18.3 s), visits the options panel (21-23.5 s) and pulls back to the whole terminal (24-25.7 s); no cuts.
